ideas.title: Establishing a Fixed Time Period of Admission and an Extension of Stay Procedure for Nonimmigrant Academic Students, Exchange Visitors, and Representatives of Foreign Information Media
ideas.reason: SHIPPED — creates real new tracking/filing duty on SEVP schools, exchange sponsors, and F-1/J-1 employers; all facts verified against primary source.

ideas.title: Margin Requirements for Uncleared Swaps for Swap Dealers and Major Swap Participants
ideas.reason: REJECTED (Phase 1 kill) — grants relief/exemption to swap dealers (seeded funds carve-out), does not impose a new duty; audience is an ultra-narrow set of CFTC-regulated swap dealers/MSPs, not a broad business class.

ideas.title: FEP Agency Designation Procedures: Revising Location of FEP Agency Lists
ideas.reason: REJECTED (Phase 1 kill) — purely government-internal/administrative: EEOC moving a list of FEP agencies from regulatory text to its website; no new business duty.

ideas.title: Food Standards of Identity Modernization; Pasteurized Orange Juice
ideas.reason: REJECTED (Phase 1 kill) — permissive/deregulatory standard change (lowers minimum solids, allows blending); optional for processors, no affirmative new duty, narrow niche audience.

ideas.title: Public Charge Ground of Inadmissibility
ideas.reason: REJECTED (Phase 1 kill) — explicit rescission/repeal of the 2022 public charge rule with no new duty created; kill category per skill rule.
